docs.title: Home
docs.text:
Production-grade agent infrastructure for AI applications. Build, deploy, and operate LLM-powered agents with the Kneo Agent SDK and the Kneo Agent Platform.

  • Kneo Agent SDK

    A framework-agnostic Python library for building agents with composable tools, MCP integrations, middleware, streaming, human-in-the-loop control, and observability.

    Read the SDK docs

  • Kneo Agent Platform

    A service and control plane that runs agents in production — YAML spec compiler, FastAPI service, Typer CLI, durable run state, pause/resume, and pluggable persistence.

    Read the platform docs

  • Kneo Agent Client

    A typed Python SDK and adapter toolkit for talking to a Kneo Agent Platform instance — auth, profiles, retries, idempotency, typed result pages, run polling, request IDs, and normalized errors.

    Read the client docs

  • Kneo Agent Dashboard

    An operations and admin UI for the Kneo Agent Platform — launch agents into staging/production, monitor runs, resolve human tasks, and review audit and health, gated by per-environment policies.

    Read the dashboard docs
